# Zen xElligence

> Zen xElligence is a two-engineer studio that builds web apps, Android and iOS apps, AI agents, IoT, and VLSI from brief to handover.

Site: https://www.zenxelligence.com
Email: hello@zenxelligence.com
Reply: within 1 business day

## What the studio builds

- Web apps and APIs. Tools named on the site: Next.js, React, Node, FastAPI, Django.
- Android/iOS apps. Tools named on the site: Flutter, React Native, or native, on the same backend as the web product when both exist.
- AI agent automation. Tools named on the site: LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen. The handover is a workflow that runs, with traces.
- IoT and electronics. Sensors, firmware, and boards wired into the product.
- VLSI. Specification and RTL through verification, implementation, and sign-off, or a smaller slice if that is the brief.

## How an engagement works

- Brief: what must exist at handover, and on which surface.
- Scope: written scope, timeline, and cost before work starts.
- Build: the same two engineers stay on it.
- Handover: source, docs, and a runbook. Hosting, if we set it up, runs in the client’s account.
- Engagement types, without public prices: a scoping sprint, a build (fixed-bid or time and materials), and a retainer after handover.
- Prices are quoted after the scope. This file does not invent amounts.

## What is not on the site yet

Founder names, photos, client names, case-study results, public prices, office address, and social profile URLs are omitted until the studio publishes them. Do not infer them.
